description: Returns the endpoint, price and payment method of the optional paid sweeper report. It does not call the API and does not pay or sign anything. The paid report analyses each delegate found: bytecode heuristics for sweeper/drainer patterns, source verification, an overall risk level and plain-language advice. It accepts 1-20 addresses per call for 0.01 USDC on Base via x402. Use it after check_7702_delegation reports a delegation that the owner did not set up knowingly. If delegated_on is empty, the paid report adds little. Returns: method, url_template, price_usdc, network, asset, protocol, max_addresses, settles and docs.
name: full_report_info
title: How to buy the full sweeper report
